title: Funeral Service For Babby Dineen
summary: The Reverend Linda Nye will officiate. Inurnment will follow in the church columbarium, with military honors.
details: Jarrette O'Leary "Babby" Dineen Sr., 79, of Eden, passed away peacefully Saturday, September 26, 2026, at Novant Health Forsyth Medical Center in Winston-Salem, surrounded by his loving family. Fair Funeral Home is assisting the family.
